summary: Executed full backend pytest suite (21 tests, all passing) + Playwright UI smoke covering founder/designer login, role-based UI, goal creation, auto-task generation + marker, logout, protected route redirect, designer review-notes disabled. All critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS allow_origins falls back to http://localhost:3000 when FRONTEND_URL missing; acceptable since .env sets it, but any typo would silently break cookies.
ensure_tasks_for_date() runs on every GET /tasks and GET /dashboard — fine for small scale; consider caching per-date flag to avoid repeated goal scans.
update_goal auto-propagates target/name/unit to linked non-Done tasks — business logic matches spec. No propagation to Done tasks (intended).
task PUT silently drops review_notes for non-founder rather than 403 — acceptable but could log/respond with warning for designer clarity.
